name: Ox The
overview: The Scriptures portray oxen as valuable possessions and symbols of prosperity, as seen in Abram's wealth which included oxen among his cattle (Genesis 12:16, 13:2). The presence of oxen alongside other livestock highlights their role in household and agricultural life, with instances of strife over herds indicating their economic importance (Genesis 13:5, 13:7). Additionally, oxen are associated with offerings and feasts, reflecting their place in worship and provision, as Abraham prepared a tender calf for a meal (Genesis 15:9, 18:7).
